Nuestra plataforma empresarial integral proporciona tarjetas de crédito o débito y un software que ofrece visibilidad en tiempo real, transparencia y eficiencia para la gestión de gastos y/o beneficios.
candidates.rationale: Directly similar fintech platform for corporate spending management and cards, targeting businesses with comparable buyer needs.

candidates.name: TotalSpent
candidates.description: Totalspent is the ultimate solution the obtain all expense receipts automaticly
candidates.rationale: Appears to be a small receipt-capture tool, not a comparable corporate cards and finance operations platform like Brex.

candidates.name: Kiotapay
candidates.description: Pay, track and reconcile every business transaction on the go Kiotapay empowers you to make all business payments from one AI-powered spend platform with flexible controls, multiple users and using all bank and Mobile money channels. Digital payments for all business spending across departments, locations, branches, projects & teams. Control spend and optimize project cost to get the most out of every coin spent. Mitigate wastage and improve planning on purpose-driven spending. Simplify bill payments, petty cash, staff salaries, travel, airtime, allowances, disbursements, marketing & sales expenses across your business with secure controls. Make your accounting easy and simplify spending by automating payments flows and reporting for the entire business.
candidates.rationale: Business spend management and payments platform for companies, closely overlapping Brex’s corporate cards, expense control, and financial operations.

candidates.name: velzi.ai
candidates.description: Revolutionizing Accounting; AI Powered Business Solutions
candidates.rationale: AI accounting software is adjacent, but not a comparable corporate spend management platform or clear Brex peer.

candidates.name: Smartledger AI
candidates.description: Deploy AI to master your financial universe. With seamless expenditure tracking, invoice management, tax handling, and profit and loss insights, our platform turns complex figures into clear forecasts, guiding your business towards informed financial planning and robust decision-making.
candidates.rationale: AI financial operations platform with expense, invoice, and tax management overlaps Brex’s spend and finance stack.
